scope: C03-specific A03/A04 cases; other tasks retain their own acceptance scope

tests: A03/A04 shared diagnosis exposes valid, absent, invalid and unsupported without trusting damaged history checksums
A04 Host offers read-only inspection and separate downloads, with incomplete files restricted to diagnosis
1.result: Shared CLI/Host diagnosis separates snapshot integrity from history; strict opening continues to reject damaged checksums.

tests: assessment keeps only the verified contiguous suffix and never mutates history
redo assessment preserves only the reachable prefix of the redo stack
history rebuild requires an exact base and exact final snapshot
A04 exact rebuild rejects wrong document identity and every incorrect recorded intermediate revision
2.result: Stop on first bad entry. Rebuild checks exact document identity, beforeRevision, each recorded afterRevision, and final head. Redo corruption preserves valid undo.

tests: repair saves a verified new copy and report while preserving source and journal byte for byte
A04 repair failures and actual process crashes preserve original, sidecar and CAS at all publication stages
A03/A04 CLI diagnoses then saves a separate recovery package and report
A04 Host offers read-only inspection and separate downloads, with incomplete files restricted to diagnosis
3.result: Exclusive save-as directory, original/report/copy preservation, injected failure and real SIGKILL before write/after temporary evidence/before publication; Host copy/report download and denied-download preservation.

tests: A04 real browser recoverySessionId isolates original tail/base and rejects quota, missing resources and corrupt snapshots
A04 unknown operations and malformed redo are diagnostic; incomplete content cannot become a recovered project
A04 generated Portable shows read-only diagnostics for incomplete resources and invalid history
Host persists edits/undo/redo, rejects stale tabs, retains marks, moves groups, and reviews conflicts
4.result: Recovery forks tail/base before attaching a writer; first-write source check preserves stale-tab rejection. Missing resources or invalid snapshots cannot produce editable recovery.

environment.browser: Playwright Chromium headless; real browser IndexedDB/localStorage and file:// Host/Portable

limitations: No OS power-loss or real Safari validation; crash tests terminate processes with SIGKILL.
Incomplete content is diagnosis-only; no object deletion or guessed resource reconstruction.
Sidecars are preserved, not automatically merged. Retained namespaces consume storage; automatic garbage collection is outside C03.
Download requests do not certify that the user retained the file.
